newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear to take stakes in Sava Group units.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear to take stakes in Sava Group units.

text.p: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said Monday it agreed with the Sava Group in Kranj, Slovenia, to take a 60 percent interest in Sava's tire business and a 75 percent interest in its engineered products business.
A letter of intent to form two separate joint ventures was signed on Friday, Goodyear said.
The Sava Group is comprised of several companies making a wide range of products and employs about 3,600, Goodyear said.
Sava reported total sales revenue of about $245 million in 1996, $177 million of which was mainly for car and commercial truck tires, Goodyear said.
The engineered products joint venture will include transmission belts, air springs and hose, Goodyear said.
Goodyera said the joint venture involving Sava's engineered products business is strategic to its growth by providing a European manufacturing based operation.
The joint venture agreements, which are due to be signed by mid-summer, are subject to final approval by both Goodyear's board and Sava's shareholders.
Goodyear said the purchase price will be announced at that time.
